::: {.key-facts}
At the 2022 census, 61,968 people lived in County Carlow, up 8.8% on 2016. It had the third smallest population of the 26 counties.

Its population in 2022 was 72% of its population in 1841, the last census before the Great Famine.

In 2025, the average monthly rent on a new tenancy in County Carlow was €1,316, the 9th highest of the 26 counties.
:::
